  Read in: 简体中文 · 正體中文 · Tiếng Việt · 日本語 · Italiano · Nederlands · Deutsch · Українська

  
  
  
  
  
  

  

  

## Start here

| You have | Go to |
|---|---|
| **An Android TV or Google TV** | [Quick start](#quick-start): a coding assistant does the work in about fifteen minutes. |
| **A Samsung, LG, Roku, Vizio or Hisense VIDAA TV** | [cleanyour.tv/not-android](https://cleanyour.tv/not-android): CleanYourTV can't run there, but you can turn off the tracking with your remote. |
| **Only an Android phone** | The community-built [Clean Your TV app](https://cleanyour.tv/app): no laptop, no coding agent. |
| **Want to see it first** | [What you get](#what-you-get): screenshots of the new home screen. |

**Official links:** [cleanyour.tv](https://cleanyour.tv) and this repo. Other domains using the name, such as
cleanyourtv.com, are not run by this project ([#1004](https://github.com/Gathin23/cleanyourtv/issues/1004)).
CleanYourTV publishes no app in any app store, and clean-your-tv.net is not ours either.

[How it works](#how-it-works) · [Quick start](#quick-start) · [What you get](#what-you-get) ·
[Supported TVs](#supported-tvs) · [Doing it by hand](#doing-it-by-hand) · [The launcher](#the-launcher) ·
[Restoring](#restoring-your-tv) · [Firmware updates](#after-a-firmware-update) ·
[Questions](#questions-people-ask) · [Contributing](#contributing)

## How it works

Android TVs have the same debug bridge as Android phones. Switch on USB debugging in the TV's
developer options, allow your computer once, and the rest is standard Android tooling:

| Step | What happens |
|---|---|
| **Back up** | The list of installed packages and settings. |
| **Disable** | The manufacturer's telemetry, ad services, content rows and preloaded junk, with `pm disable-user`. Nothing is uninstalled, so a restore script can undo every step. |
| **Install** | A small native launcher, made the default home screen. |

**No root, no cable, nothing uninstalled, and a one-line restore if you change your mind.**

The bloat differs by brand, so the prompt has your coding assistant discover it on your TV and ask
before touching anything you might use.

## Quick start

| You have | Do this |
|---|---|
| **A computer** | Use the prompt with a coding assistant: the three steps below. |
| **A computer, no coding assistant** | Run the three steps yourself: the commands are in [Doing it by hand](#doing-it-by-hand). |
| **Only an Android phone** | Use the community-built [Clean Your TV app](https://cleanyour.tv/app) by [@udhaykumarbala](https://github.com/udhaykumarbala): connect, analyse, clean, in about five minutes. No laptop, no coding agent. |

The three steps below are written for a coding assistant: the computer needs to be on the same Wi-Fi as
the TV, with a shell on it, plus Python 3, a JDK from 17 through 22, and Android SDK platform 34
with build-tools 34 (the assistant builds the launcher there).
Without an assistant, [Doing it by hand](#doing-it-by-hand)
is the same job, run by you, and it has the install commands.

Any of these work: Claude Code (on [0G Private Computer](https://pc.0g.ai/?utm_source=cleanyourtv&utm_medium=github&utm_campaign=readme) or an [Anthropic plan](https://claude.com/pricing)), [Codex](https://github.com/openai/codex), [Gemini CLI](https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli) or [Antigravity CLI](https://antigravity.google/product/antigravity-cli).

| Where | What to do |
|---|---|
| **1. On the TV** | Settings → Device Preferences → About → press OK on **Build** seven times → back → Developer options → **USB debugging** on. If you see a Network or ADB debugging toggle, turn that on too. Keep the TV on. |
| **2. On your computer** | Clone the repo and open that folder in your assistant (`git clone https://github.com/Gathin23/cleanyourtv`), then paste [`PROMPT.md`](PROMPT.md) and fill in your TV model. |
| **3. Follow along** | Accept "Allow USB debugging?" on the TV, then answer the checklist: which apps you use, the dock size and app order, whether to keep the voice assistant, Chromecast and updates. |

Cloning matters: the assistant reuses this repo's `tools/disable.sh` and `launcher/build-and-install.sh`
instead of writing its own, and that is where the backup, the Home guard and the restore record live.

The assistant backs up, debloats, builds and installs the launcher, and checks each step with
screenshots pulled from the TV. With this repo as context it takes about fifteen minutes.

## What you get

A home screen that looks like an Apple TV and gets out of the way:

| Part | What it looks like |
|---|---|
| **A pitch-black home** | A dock of your four favourite apps in a rounded band, where Apple TV puts it. |
| **A top shelf** | Names the focused app in large type, with an ambient glow in a colour taken from its artwork. |
| **The rest of your apps in a grid** | Slides up when you press Down. |
| **One floating glass highlight** | Springs from tile to tile. The focused tile lifts and shows its name. |
| **Three frosted buttons** | Inputs (HDMI ports under the names you gave them in the TV's settings, AV, Live TV), Wi-Fi or Ethernet with the network name, Settings. |
| **A greeting, a thin clock and the date** | In [Outfit](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Outfit), and a matching Clock screensaver. Set `show_stats` in config or a theme for one line under the clock: CPU, free memory and free storage. It stays off unless you turn it on, and it refreshes only while Home is on screen. |
| **Themes and module cards** | Themes change colours, wallpaper, dock and columns without a rebuild, and module cards let other apps plug a tile in, only with your say-so. |

And a TV that stops working against you: no sponsored rows, no "Discover" nags, no analytics
phoning home, no apps you never asked for.

oss.readme:
# unslop

Created by Damir Sokolovsky ([@heydamir](https://x.com/heydamir)), who started the [Unslopping series](https://x.com/heydamir/status/2115063463063998736) on X.

![A vibecoded dashboard unslopping itself, frame by frame](skills/unslop/references/refs/story-dashboard-frames.webp)

unslop is a skill for Claude that turns vibecoded, AI-looking UI into a designed interface with its own character. It finds the slop first, the purple gradients, glows, emoji labels, shouty copy and uneven spacing, then sets a direction from your product and fixes the screen pass by pass like a designer doing a redline review. It works in whatever your screen is built with, like Next.js, React, Vue, Svelte, Tailwind or plain HTML and CSS, on dashboards, apps and landing pages, and even on a live site when all you have is a link.

## Install

For Claude Code, copy the skill into your skills folder.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/heydamir/unslop
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills && cp -r unslop/skills/unslop ~/.claude/skills/
```

For a single project, copy it into `.claude/skills/` inside that project instead.

## Use

In Claude Code, type `/unslop` with what you want, or just ask in your own words and Claude picks the skill up by itself.

```
/unslop this dashboard
/unslop the hero of https://example.com
/unslop my landing page and make the story video so I can post it
```

It audits the screen and proposes a direction before it edits anything, so you can steer it early. If the screen is already good, it tells you so and suggests a few small refinements instead of redesigning it.

## What it does

- **Audit.** Lists every sign of slop with where it lives.
- **Direction.** Character, world, the one or two moments that carry the color, and a signature detail, all taken from your product.
- **Passes.** Spacing, color, icons, copy, type, layout, details, visuals and motion, in that order.
- **Visuals.** Shows your product instead of a glossy blob. When a hero needs a scene or an object, it can generate one through an image service like fal, Replicate, OpenAI images or Higgsfield. If none is connected, it offers to connect one as an MCP server, and it shows the prompt and asks before every paid generation. Dashboards and apps rarely need one.
- **Story video.** A square video under 10 seconds of your screen unslopping itself, ready to post. It needs Playwright and ffmpeg.

Try it on the two vibecoded screens in [examples](examples).

## Hire the unslopper

Would rather have a designer do it? Damir unslops one key screen in 3 days, built in your stack, at [heydamir.design/unslop](https://heydamir.design/unslop).

原站是ギア（@giaaibusi）发布的三大 AI 绘画参考图库（姿势、服装、人像），元数据全部为日文，且分散在三个独立站点。本仓库（v2.0）完成了**三站合一、全量中文化、AI 角色合成工作台与 ComfyUI 原生插件升级**：

   - 支持拖拽、剪贴板粘贴（`Cmd+V` / `Ctrl+V`）或 URL 添加多张自定义附加参考图；
   - 内置 **5 大 AI 图像协议直连**（Google Gemini、OpenAI GPT Image、阿里云百炼 Qwen、字节火山方舟 Doubao、**本地 ComfyUI**），生成记录通过 **IndexedDB** 本地持久化保存。
4. **原生 ComfyUI 自定义节点插件（`custom_nodes`）** —— 本仓库同时是一个即插即用的 ComfyUI 插件！直接 `git clone` 到 `ComfyUI/custom_nodes/` 即可在 ComfyUI 画布内使用 **姿势 / 服装 / 人像 / 三合一角色配方** 4 个自定义节点与内置的 **4,345 张中文可视化弹窗选图器**。

---

## 核心功能

### 1. 三大参考图库（姿势 / 服装 / 人像）
- **姿势参考库（`/poses`）**：4 大体系（全身单人・标准系 / 全身单人・性感系 / 上半身单人 / 双人缠绵）、26 个动作分类、288 组姿势、5 种视角（正面 / 斜前 / 侧面 / 背面 / 俯视），支持**按姿势分组 / 逐张浏览**双模式及卡片内多角度切换。
- **服装参考库（`/costumes`）**：8 大穿搭分类（春季 / 夏季 / 秋季 / 冬季 / 内衣・睡衣 / 性感穿搭 / 泳装・度假 / 派对・礼服）、86 个中文细节标签与英文 Prompt 关键词。
- **人像参考库（`/portraits`）**：2 大分区（正脸参考 893 / 造型氛围 606）、4 种发长（短发 / 中发 / 中长发 / 长发）、51 种细分发型，支持**精选题集**与**热门榜单**一键筛选。
- **统一交互体验**：中文关键词实时检索、灯箱高清原图预览与下载、一键「加入合成配方」。

### 2. AI 角色合成台（`/studio`）
- **3+N 参考图组合**：3 个核心槽位（人像 / 服装 / 姿势）+ 任意张自定义附加参考图（点击上传、拖拽文件、剪贴板粘贴、填写图片 URL）。
- **参考拼图预览与导出**：弹窗查看三合一高清参考拼图（`1800×1200` Canvas 实时合成），支持一键下载拼图 PNG。
- **12 种画风预设 & 纯中文结构化提示词**：内置「无预设（跟随参考图）」、写实人像写真、日韩杂志画报、复古胶片写真、2.5D 游戏原画立绘、日系二次元插画、新海诚感动画电影、日式黑白漫画网点、3D 次世代角色渲染、3D 潮玩手办质感、赛博朋克霓虹、角色设定集立绘（纯白底）共 12 种画风，根据已选素材自动组装提示词。
- **5 大 AI 图像协议与高级参数**：
  - **Google Gemini**：`gemini-3.1-flash-image-preview`、`gemini-3-pro-image-preview`、`gemini-2.5-flash-image`（支持宽高比 `aspectRatio`、分辨率 `1K/2K/4K`）
  - **OpenAI GPT Image**：`gpt-image-2.5`、`gpt-image-2`、`gpt-image-1.5`、`gpt-image-1`（支持 `/v1/images/edits` JSON URL 直传 / Multipart 上传、尺寸、质量、背景透明度）
  - **阿里云百炼 Qwen**：`qwen-image-3.0-pro`、`qwen-image-2.1-pro`、`qwen-image-2.0-pro`、`qwen-image-edit-plus`（支持 `multimodal-generation` 多图参考输入、智能改写 `prompt_extend`、水印开关）
  - **字节火山方舟 Doubao**：`doubao-seedream-5-0`、`doubao-seedream-4-5-251128`、`doubao-seedream-4-0-250828`、`doubao-seededit-3-0-i2i-250628`（支持多图融合 `image: [...]`、2K/4K 分辨率）
  - **本地 ComfyUI 工作流引擎**：支持自动将三合一拼图及单张人像/服装/姿势图上传至本地 ComfyUI（`/upload/image`），注入自定义 API 工作流占位符或自动识别节点提交 `/prompt` 队列并轮询取回成品图；支持导入/导出通用 `.api.json` 工作流模板。
- **跨页面后台生图 & IndexedDB 历史记录**：切换页面不会中断正在进行的生图请求；生成结果自动存入浏览器 IndexedDB（避免 `localStorage` 容量限制），支持复用提示词与原图下载。

### 3. ComfyUI 原生自定义节点插件（`comfyui_plugin/`）
将本仓库克隆到 `ComfyUI/custom_nodes/ai-pose-gallery-zh` 后，ComfyUI 画布右键菜单 **「AI角色三合一参考图集」** 下自动提供 4 个节点：

- **AI 服装参考图 (`CostumeGalleryNode`)**：输出 `服装图 (IMAGE)`、`图片ID`、`中文服装描述`、`英文服装Prompt`
- **AI 人像参考图 (`PortraitGalleryNode`)**：输出 `人像图 (IMAGE)`、`图片ID`、`人像发型描述`
- **AI 角色三合一合成配方 (`CharacterRecipeNode`)**：单节点同时输出 `人像图`、`服装图`、`姿势图`、`三合一拼图` 以及自动组装的 `中文合成Prompt` 与 `英文合成Prompt`，并内置 **4,345 张中文可视化弹窗选图器**与节点内实时缩略图预览。

## 在 ComfyUI 中使用（双模式支持）

### 模式 A：作为 ComfyUI 原生插件安装（在 ComfyUI 画布内选图）

无需安装额外 Python 依赖（直接复用 ComfyUI 自带的 `torch`、`numpy`、`Pillow`、`aiohttp`）：

```bash
cd /path/to/ComfyUI/custom_nodes
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/anhao/ai-pose-gallery-zh.git
```

重启 ComfyUI 后：
1. 在画布空白处右键 → **新建节点** → **AI角色三合一参考图集**；
2. 选择 **「AI 角色三合一合成配方 (3-in-1 Recipe)」** 或单个姿势 / 服装 / 人像节点；
3. 点击节点上的 **「🎨 打开三合一选图器 (4,345张)」** 按钮（或直接点击节点上的缩略图），即可在弹窗中按分类、视角、发长筛选或中文搜索，一键填入节点并输出 `IMAGE` 张量与中英文 Prompt。

### 模式 B：从 Web 合成台直连本地 ComfyUI API

如果您使用线上网页端（或本地 `pnpm dev`）选图，希望直接调用本机 ComfyUI 生图：
1. 启动本地 ComfyUI 时开启跨域参数：
   ```bash
   python main.py --enable-cors-header "*"
   ```
2. 打开本工作台 **「接口配置」** 页面 → 切换到 **「本地 ComfyUI」** → 点击「检测连接」（默认 `http://127.0.0.1:8188`）；
3. 可直接导入您在 ComfyUI 中通过 `工作流 -> 导出 (API)` 保存的 `.json` 文件（支持 `{{prompt}}`、`{{seed}}`、`{{width}}`、`{{height}}`、`{{composite_image}}`、`{{portrait_image}}`、`{{costume_image}}`、`{{pose_image}}` 占位符，或由系统自动匹配 `CLIPTextEncode` / `KSampler` / `LoadImage` 节点），也可在 **「合成台」** 一键导出内置通用工作流模板。

简体中文 · English

  
    
    
  

  DeepSeek Harness 的 Android 客户端。手机上直接跑，也能遥控你电脑上的 DSH。

  
  
  
  

Deepy 和鲸娘，陪你干活

干活时敲代码，做完来个空翻，等你确认会举手。打开「App 外显示」，它们还会跟你到桌面。

     

     

下载 DSH Go

从 GitHub Releases 或官网下载页获取最新版 APK，常见手机选 arm64 包。

   

  感谢大家对 DSH Go 的支持和喜爱，我将尽快适配 iOS 和鸿蒙！大家 Star 点得越多，我适配得越快哦 hhh

  

  第一次用可以先看使用指南，遇到问题欢迎来论坛和 QQ 群。
  手机上装过签名不同的早期测试包时不能直接覆盖安装，需要先卸载旧版；卸载会清空对话、Linux 环境和设置。

本机运行，也能遥控电脑

内置 Linux 环境，免 Root、免 Termux。电脑上的 DSH，也能一键切过去接着用。

  
    
    
  

插话、打断，过程自动收好

回复中途也能插话，排队的消息随时「立即发送」。做完的过程折叠成一行。

  
    
    
  

原生界面，也有网页版

和官方网页版一键切换，停在同一段对话，下次打开还是你上次用的那个。

  
    
    
  

分享卡、对话回放和链接

回复一键做成分享卡。整段对话生成链接，对方在浏览器里回放，链接端到端加密。

  
    
    
  

横屏与平板

横屏手机和平板重新排版：侧栏常驻，内容居中，弹出键盘也不挤。

  
    
    
  

主题配色与桌面图标

六套主题色，也能跟随壁纸或自选颜色。四款桌面图标，三种功能图标风格。

  
    
    
  

中文，也说 English

全部界面支持英文，在设置里切换，默认跟随系统。

  
    
    
  

手机操控

看屏幕、帮你点，三档确认随你选。付款、密码和验证码，永远交还给你。

  
    
    
  

## 可以做什么

DSH Go 提供聊天界面、本机运行环境和远程连接，是基于 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的第三方项目。运行在手机上的是 DSH 引擎；模型请求仍由你配置的模型提供方处理。

- **本机运行**：在 App 内安装 Ubuntu、Node.js 与 DSH 运行环境，无需 Root 或另装 Termux。
- **远程连接**：通过 SSH 或 DSH Remote 使用电脑、服务器上的 DSH。
- **聊天与工具**：切换模型，发送图片、使用语音输入，处理工具审批和提问；支持聊天界面与网页模式。
- **插件界面**：使用适配 DSH Go 的原生工具卡、表单和面板；仓库提供 SDK、教程和示例。
- **手机操控**：在你开启权限后，让本机引擎读取屏幕、点按和输入，并可随时停止。
- **分享与外观**：分享、导出和回放对话，调整主题、图标和桌宠。

功能随主机和连接方式不同。DSH Remote 当前只支持图片附件，不能在 App 内打开网页版，插件管理限于开关，且不支持 DS Bot 和对话日志导出。详见[本机引擎与远程主机](docs/guide/zh/03-engine-hosts.md)。

## 安装

安装要求为 Android 8.0（API 26）及以上。Release 页面上的 **arm64** 安装包适用于常见的 64 位 Android 手机；x86_64 设备和模拟器用的 x64 包在发布说明末尾的「其他版本下载」里。仓库没有 32 位 ARM 构建。

1. 从 [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-go/releases/latest) 或[官网下载页](https://go.dshtui.com/download)下载对应架构的 APK，并按系统提示允许该安装来源。
2. 首次启动时，选择在本机安装运行环境，或连接远程主机。
3. 为所选主机配置模型和所需凭据，再开始对话；部分远程渠道需要在主机侧配置。

仅连接远程主机时，不必在手机上安装本机运行环境。手机操控只对正常模式下的本机引擎开放，需要按界面说明开启无障碍等权限；不打扰模式另外要求 Android 14 及以上，以及 Shizuku 或自连 ADB。首次使用可按[使用指南](docs/guide/README.md)逐项配置。

本地引擎默认使用 PRoot 兼容启动。开发者选项中的直接启动默认关闭，开启后的兼容性和回退方式见[常见问题](docs/guide/zh/11-faq.md)。当前 Android 构建以 APK 侧载为目标，不是 Google Play 发布配置。

## 数据与权限

模型请求会发送给你配置的提供方。开启手机操控后，任务需要的屏幕文字可能发送给模型，支持看图的模型也可能收到截图；请先阅读 App 的权限说明。

“发送匿名使用统计”默认开启，可在首次引导或“设置 → 隐私与分享”关闭。采集范围和关闭后的处理见[常见问题](docs/guide/zh/11-faq.md)。分享内容前，请检查预览；收到链接或文件的人可以保存其中的内容。

## 常见问题

和 DeepSeek 官方是什么关系？

没有关系。DSH Go 是社区开发的非官方客户端，基于开源的 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 构建。手机上运行的是 DSH 本身；模型请求发给你配置的模型提供方，需要联网，按你在提供方的账户计费。

安全吗？

本机网页版只接受 App 自己的访问。分享链接端到端加密，密钥只在链接里，服务器看不到内容。手机操控遇到付款、密码、验证码和系统设置，一律交还给你。

切到后台会被杀吗？

部分系统的省电策略会拦住后台。DSH Go 发现后会提醒你，并直达对应的放行设置，vivo、小米、华为、荣耀、OPPO 都有。

对手机有什么要求？

Android 8 及以上。手机直接下载 Release 页面上的安装包即可，模拟器用的 x86_64 版在发布说明末尾的「其他版本下载」里。在手机上运行 DSH 要先准备内置的运行环境，请预留约 1 GB 空间；只连电脑或服务器上的 DSH 可以不装。

开源吗？

开源，代码就在这个仓库，以 [AGPL-3.0](LICENSE) 发布，`sdk/` 和 `examples/` 为 MIT。DSH Go 的名称和标识，以及 Deepy、鲸娘两位吉祥物，不在开源授权范围内，见 [ASSETS.md](ASSETS.md)。

## 从源码构建

以下流程面向 **Linux x86_64**。当前工具链脚本默认安装 JDK 17、Flutter 3.47.7 和 Android SDK/NDK；App 要求 Dart `^3.13.5`。准备 Bash、Git、curl、tar、unzip、xz、Python 3、zstd（Python 未提供 `compression.zstd` 时用于解包 zstd 压缩的 deb）、file 和常见 GNU 命令；重新解析 Ubuntu 软件包锁时还需要 gpgv。

先取得完整源码和项目资源。`app/pubspec.yaml` 声明的字体、图片等都是构建输入，运行时包由下面的脚本生成。

```bash
git clone https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-go.git
cd dsh-go

bash tooling/setup-toolchain.sh
source tooling/env.sh
flutter --version
java -version

bash runtime/build-runtime.sh arm64-v8a
DSH_BETA_TOKEN_FILE= bash tooling/build-apk.sh -f arm64 --keep-daemon
```

工具链脚本会下载 SDK/NDK 与模拟器镜像，并执行 Android SDK 许可接受步骤。默认安装到 `~/dev`；可通过 `DEV_ROOT` 指定独立目录。脚本会复用已有安装，构建前请核对版本。

产物为 `app/build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-arm64-release.apk`。运行时构建使用仓库固定的版本与校验信息，并需要联网下载依赖。示例中的 `DSH_BETA_TOKEN_FILE=` 不嵌入维护者的内测通道令牌；`--keep-daemon` 保留 Gradle daemon，适合同时开发其他 Android 项目的环境。

构建 x86_64 包时，先生成对应运行时：

```bash
bash runtime/build-runtime.sh x86_64
DSH_BETA_TOKEN_FILE= bash tooling/build-apk.sh -f x64 --keep-daemon
```

未配置 `app/android/key.properties` 时，本地 release 构建使用 debug 签名。它不能直接覆盖不同签名的官方安装包；请在测试设备上安装，保留已有数据，不要为解决签名冲突直接卸载正在使用的 App。发布签名与密钥文件不要提交到仓库。

只查看 APK 构建命令，可运行：

```bash
DSH_BETA_TOKEN_FILE= bash tooling/build-apk.sh --dry-run -f all
```

## 目录

| 路径 | 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| `app/` | Flutter 界面与 Android Kotlin 平台实现 |
| `packages/dsh_client/` | DSH Web API 的 Dart 客户端 |
| `packages/dsh_remote/` | DSH Remote 的 Dart 客户端 |
| `runtime/` | Linux 运行时打包、引擎补丁与 App 桥接 |

| `docs/assets/` | 本页用到的展示图、桌宠动图和社群二维码 |
| `tooling/` | 工具链、APK 构建与诊断脚本 |
| `services/`、`site/`、`infra/` | 配套分享服务、网站和部署材料 |

## 参与贡献

问题反馈和改进建议可提交到 [Issues](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-go/issues)。代码、文档和翻译贡献请先看 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)。插件作者可以从[插件教程](docs/plugins/README.md)和 [SDK](sdk/plugin-kit/README.md)开始。

安全问题请按 [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) 报告，避免在公开 Issue 中提交漏洞细节或凭据。

## 社区

# Horizon

Minecraft: Java Edition 26.3, rewritten in Rust. Same worlds, same rules, same terrain, checked against the Java game by more than 300 differential harnesses. Free, open source and unofficial.

> Not an official Minecraft product, nor approved by or associated with Mojang or Microsoft. Horizon contains no Minecraft code, assets or data: you need your own copy of Java Edition 26.3.

## Download

Get **the Horizon launcher** from [playhorizon.dev](https://playhorizon.dev) or [the launcher releases](https://github.com/horizon-rust/horizon/releases?q=launcher-v&expanded=true) (Linux x86-64, macOS on Apple Silicon, macOS on Intel from the next Nightly, Windows x64). It installs and updates the game, prepares its files from your copy of Minecraft, and updates itself.

**You need** a Microsoft account that owns Java Edition ([why](docs/microsoft-account.md)) and a GPU with Vulkan or OpenGL 3.3 (Linux), Vulkan or DirectX 12 (Windows), or a Mac (Apple Silicon, or Intel from the next Nightly). An existing Minecraft install (official launcher, Prism, MultiMC...) is reused; without one, Play downloads 26.3 from Mojang for your account. Step by step: [Install and first launch](https://playhorizon.dev/docs/install).

  
    
    
  

## What works today

- **The game:** vanilla world generation, mobs, villagers, raids, redstone, every command, the HUD and the recipe book, on vanilla saves. Worlds from 1.8 to 26.2 are upgraded. [Status](#project-status).
- **Extras:** new menus, graphics presets, distant terrain up to 1024 chunks, controllers, zoom, minimap and more, off by default where they change the vanilla look. [Settings](https://playhorizon.dev/docs/settings).
- **Packs:** resource packs, and data packs with functions, predicates, item modifiers and world generation.
- **Multiplayer:** invite friends with a code, Open to LAN, join servers (online mode included). [Multiplayer](https://playhorizon.dev/docs/multiplayer).
- **Mods:** content mods (blocks, items, data) and native Rust mods, built by the launcher with nothing to install. Java mod jars do not run. [Mods](https://playhorizon.dev/docs/mods).

In the Rust client, with vanilla assets and no mods or shaders:

  
    
  
  
    
    
  
  
    
    
  

## Host a server

The launcher's **Servers** page creates, starts, backs up and updates a server, and invites friends over Tailscale. On a VPS, `horizon-server` installs with one command and needs no Java. [Host a server](https://playhorizon.dev/docs/hosting) ([reference](docs/hosting.md)).

## Modpacks

The launcher imports Modrinth and CurseForge packs and plays the mods Horizon can carry over: today, content mods made of data and assets, not Java code. [Modpacks](https://playhorizon.dev/docs/modpacks).

## Agent control

AI agents and scripts can play Horizon. `horizon-ctl`, shipped with the game, reads its state as JSON and acts like a player; `horizon-ctl mcp` serves the same commands over MCP.

```sh
horizon-ctl launch --world Survival --seed 5 --wait   # finds the version the launcher installed
horizon-ctl state                                       # position, health, food, target, screen...
horizon-ctl find-block birch_log                        # the nearest logs
horizon-ctl goto -0.5 65 -2.5 --near 2.5                # walks there along a path
horizon-ctl break -1 65 -3                              # mines it; replies with the drops
horizon-ctl open-inventory && horizon-ctl click-slot 0  # menus: slots, buttons by label, text fields
```

Commands block until done and reply with the result; `horizon-ctl help` lists them all. [Agent control](docs/native-client.md#agent-control-horizon-ctl-and-mcp).

## Build from source

Needs Rust 1.90+, Python 3.10+, JDK 25, and on Linux `libasound2-dev libudev-dev`. `horizon-prepare` builds the game's resources from **your own copy** of Java Edition 26.3 (checked against `research-lock.json`) and never downloads it:

1. **Client:** play 26.3 once in the official launcher. Horizon reads `~/.minecraft` (or `--minecraft-dir` / `HORIZON_MINECRAFT_DIR`).
2. **Server jar:** the 26.3 server jar (`downloads.server.url` in `versions/26.3/26.3.json`), passed once with `--server-jar` or `HORIZON_SERVER_JAR`.

```sh
git clone https://github.com/horizon-rust/horizon.git
cd horizon
cargo run --release -p horizon-prepare -- --prepare --server-jar ~/Downloads/server.jar   # needs JDK 25
cargo run --release -p horizon-prepare -- sounds   # optional: sounds from your launcher install
cargo run --release -p horizon-client
```

Prepared files land in the gitignored `.local/`: never commit or share them. Options, controls and architecture: [the native client guide](docs/native-client.md); all developer docs: [docs/README.md](docs/README.md).

## Roadmap

# nxnative

Play your own Nintendo Switch games natively on iPhone and iPad. Bring your game (its NSP files) and your `prod.keys`; one script turns them into an IPA that you sideload.

It is not an emulator: the game's own code runs directly on the Apple chip, with Switch graphics rebuilt on Metal. Nothing from any game is in this repository, and the project is not affiliated with Nintendo or any game publisher.

## How to play

### With a Mac app

Community projects build on nxnative with Mac apps that turn your games into apps for your iPhone, iPad or Mac, with no command line, and keep them in a library. They are separate projects: questions and bugs about them go to their own pages.

- [NX2Apple](https://github.com/LNPANDY/NX2Apple)
- [NX Play](https://github.com/varyform/nx-native-wrapper)
- [NxNative Launcher](https://github.com/rennan101/nxnative_Launcher)
- [LumaNX](https://github.com/Xc1Ym/LumaNX)

- Added `permissions.blockWritesOutsideWorkingDirectories`: Write, Edit and NotebookEdit refuse paths outside the working directories in every permission mode
- Added an optional `groups` list to Claude apps gateway upstreams: only developers in the listed IdP groups are sent to that upstream, on failover too
- Added `guardrail_trace` to Claude apps gateway Bedrock upstreams, to log which Amazon Bedrock guardrail filter fired on a request, without the matched text
- Added idle compaction to VS Code and Claude Desktop's Code tab: a 200K+ token conversation left idle is summarized, and the summary is used on your next message if the prompt cache has expired
- Fixed sessions failing turn after turn with "Invalid effort level" when an organization's admin caps a model's effort: Claude Code now lowers the effort, retries, and says which level it uses
- Fixed `claude -p` exiting with code 0 and no output when startup failed; it now prints the error and exits 1
